item.title: Our Opinion: Keep questions coming in data center hearings
item.description: At a town-hall meeting he organized, to speak about an issue that has been boiling over throughout Northeast Pennsylvania over the last year, Republican state Rep. Jamie Walsh got to the heart of the matter when it came to the fears and concerns of a data center boom hitting our region.

item.title: Knights of Columbus free-throw contest
item.description: The Knights of Columbus Corpus Christi Council 12573, Montdale, held its annual free-throw competition recently. Participants and winners, from left: Jerry Borosky, K of C youth director; Lucca Chang, 9-year-old boys winner; Rocco Chang, 11-year-old boys winner; Tate Anderson, 10-year-old boys; Colton Barry, 11-year-old boys; Evan Rosenkrans, 10-year-old boys winner; Natalie Nagle, 10-year-old girls winner; and Abby Ross, 14-year-old girls winner. The winners advance to the district level.

item.title: Post 7069 donates to Boy Scouts
item.description: VFW Abington Memorial Post 7069, Clarks Summit, presented BSA Troop 160, Clarks Summit, with a check for $500 in support of the troop’s ongoing programs and community endeavors. From left: Michael McLane, Post 7069 quartermaster/adjutant; Tom Tone and Dave Jones, Troop 160 assistant scoutmasters; and Donald Jones, Post 7069 commander.

item.title: NE REGIONAL WRESTLING: Schuman, Caines capture Class 2A crowns
item.description: Honesdale’s Nathan Schuman and Hanover Area’s CJ Caines can define their seasons with one word — domination. Saturday proved no different. The sophomore wrestlers, who have a combined record of 90-1 on the season, captured Class 2A Northeast Regional titles at Williamsport High School, with seven points being the closest margin of victory.
